summary: First hotfix for Starfall Outpost, focused on co-op stability and save safety.

fixes.description: Oxygen reactor output now replicates correctly after host migration.
Cryo-sleep autosaves are now written atomically; suspending the console mid-save no longer corrupts the save or its backup.
Fixed Switch friend invites failing with error SO-4012.
Subtitles no longer overlap the radio comms box in handheld mode.

known_issues: Hover-rover can fall through terrain in Ridge Canyon.

summary: The Frozen Belt update: a new ice moon, the ORB-7 companion drone and thermal suits, plus a batch of launch fixes.

fixes.description: Fixed the hover-rover falling through steep terrain in Ridge Canyon.
Building placement preview now matches the final position on slopes.
Fusion Welding now unlocks when its requirements are met.
Dust storm ambience now stops when the storm ends.
DualSense trigger resistance resets when the drill is holstered.

known_issues: Large hydroponic farms can reduce frame rate.

summary: Hotfix for Frozen Belt stability on Switch and voice chat in 4-player sessions.

fixes.description: Fixed a crash when docking or undocking during loading screens.
Proximity voice chat now supports all players in a session.
Ice caves are now correctly lit in handheld mode.
ORB-7 no longer gets stuck in airlock doors.

known_issues: Long sessions on Xbox Series S may run out of memory.

summary: The Deep Core update: mining lasers, Tier 2 fusion reactors and cross-save.

fixes.description: Fixed an item duplication exploit during host migration.
Hydroponic planters are now instanced, greatly improving performance in large farms.
Thermal suit gauge now respects the Units setting.
'Signal in the Ice' marker now points to the correct crater.
Mouse cursor no longer appears in gamepad mode after alt-tab.

known_issues: Long sessions on Xbox Series S may run out of memory.

summary: Critical fix for the cross-save conflict dialog and long-session memory growth.

fixes.description: Fixed memory growth from weather effects during long sessions.
'Keep Local' and 'Keep Cloud' in the cross-save dialog now do what they say.
Friends-only lobbies now accept cross-platform Starfall friends.
Automatic matchmaking region now prefers the nearest region.

known_issues: Tutorial can stall if the oxygen reactor is built early.

summary: Outpost Alliance: 8-player co-op, trade terminals and shared research.

fixes.description: Tier 2 reactor power graph no longer shows negative values.
Improved HDR calibration range.
Added missing footstep sounds on Deep Core grating (Switch).
Oxygen reactors resume production correctly after loading a save.
Boulders no longer get launched when a neighbour is mined.

known_issues: Hosting 8-player sessions on PS5 can cause periodic hitches.
Tutorial can stall if the oxygen reactor is built early.

summary: Performance and progression fixes for Outpost Alliance.

fixes.description: Reduced host CPU cost of replication in 8-player sessions.
Trade terminals are now locked to one player at a time.
The tutorial reactor objective completes if the reactor was built early.
Cold Feet trophy now unlocks correctly.
Aim assist no longer affects the mining laser.

known_issues: Texture pop-in in the Deep Core on Switch.

summary: Storm Season: dynamic lightning storms, lightning rods, storm shutters and wind power.

fixes.description: Rover passengers now see smooth vehicle movement.
Restored texture streaming budget on Switch.
Power wires now follow the colourblind palette.
Fixed shadow flicker in habitat domes at dusk.
Reduced the GPU cost of many simultaneous mining lasers.

known_issues: Lightning can damage anchored structures near lightning rods.

summary: Storm Season hotfix for lightning rods and client movement.

fixes.description: Lightning rods now protect anchored structures within 30 m.
Eye of the Storm trophy now unlocks.
Reduced client rubberbanding in the Deep Core mines.
Fixed radio crackle with PS Link headsets.

known_issues: Loading an autosave made during a storm can spawn a second storm.

summary: Small quality-of-life patch for Storm Season.

fixes.description: Loading a save made during a storm no longer spawns a second storm.
Rain is now muffled inside sealed habitat modules.
Wind turbines now generate power during storms.
Habitat doors open on the first Joy-Con press.

known_issues: Storm shutters do not show snap points on curved dome walls.
